style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI for a cozy office game, top-down three-quarter view. Big head >= one third of full height (target 38-42 percent). Big expressive eyes with visible ivory square highlights, NEVER plain dot eyes. Strong recognizable hair/headgear silhouette, warm readable limited palette, dark plum-brown selective one-pixel outline, 3-4 hard-edged tone shading per material. Deliberate chunky SQUARE pixels, no vector/cartoon smooth curves, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no dithering. Target final full body approximately 26 x 46 logical pixels inside interchangeable 32 x 64 cell. Character identity stays identical across every row, same head scale and clothing layers. Keep head details large enough to survive final cell extraction. No scenery, furniture, shadows, detached symbols, steam, punctuation, text or grid. Background uniformly pure magenta #FF00FF. Do not use magenta or near-magenta in the subject. IDENTITY LOCK: Young androgynous slim skater with short compact limbs, huge round warm peach head, big expressive dark blue eyes with an ivory square catchlight in each eye and cheeky smile. TALL ELECTRIC-BLUE MOHAWK: one narrow central ridge of five angular spikes, cyan highlights, cobalt shadows, shaved warm peach sides, from forehead over crown to nape; front crest NARROW, profile crest sawtooth tall. Tiny silver hoop earring on anatomical left ear. Charcoal black open sleeveless vest with broad lapels, burnt-orange square patch on anatomical left chest and cream patch on opposite chest; cream band T-shirt with small dark navy lightning graphic, NO text. Bare peach forearms, cuffed slate-blue ripped jeans with two peach knee rips; chunky ivory sneakers with black soles and blue laces. No beard, no cap, no scarf, no skateboard. Young cozy friendly punk, thin tapered body with big head and tall crest.
